items.title: Brown-Forman Q1 Earnings Meet, Sales Miss on Tequila & Barrel Weakness
items.summary: BF.B's Q1 EPS meets estimates, but sales fall 1% y/y as tequila, used barrels and Korbel weigh, while RTD sales jump 20%.

items.title: Is Coca-Cola Still an Elite Dividend Stock? Here’s What the Numbers Say
items.summary: Coca-Cola just extended a dividend streak that spans six decades, but a surging stock price and a tight payout ratio raise real questions about whether this legendary income name still delivers for buyers entering today.

items.title: PepsiCo hands global media to Publicis amid transformation at CPG giant
items.summary: Omnicom was the incumbent on the account, which is moving agencies as PepsiCo navigates changing consumer appetites and technology demands.

items.title: 3 Mega-Cap Stocks with Solid Fundamentals
items.summary: Megacap stocks are behemoths that set the tone for their industries, and their massive scale typically leads to wide moats. However, the downside is that most have already exploited their existing market opportunities and must invest heavily to expand further, a risky proposition.

items.title: How Berkshire’s New CEO Plans to Protect Iowa Power Costs From Hyperscaler Data Center Expansion
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway  CEO Greg Abel said the company will only provide power for new data centers if other utility customers benefit.  In a wide-ranging interview Wednesday morning with CNBC from Tokyo—where Abel is visiting with several large Japanese trading companies in which Berkshire has investments—the CEO discussed how Berkshire’s big utility, Berkshire Hathaway Energy, approaches data centers.

items.title: Want Income for Life? Coca-Cola Has Raised Its Dividend for 64 Straight Years and Yields 2.4%. Here's Whether It Belongs in Your Portfolio.
items.summary: Coca-Cola is a compelling income investment because its modest yield is supported by durable business growth, innovation, and 64 consecutive years of dividend increases.

items.title: Coca-Cola (KO) Faces Supply Chain Scrutiny, Is The Stock Already Fully Valued?
items.summary: Indian authorities recently seized thousands of beverage cartons in an alleged expiry date relabeling case, with Coca-Cola (KO) products among those affected through a third party exporter. For investors, the spotlight is on supply chain oversight and brand protection. Coca-Cola shares have eased in the very short term, with a 1-day share price return of 0.76% and a 7-day share price return of 3.97%. However, the stock still shows strong momentum, with a 90-day share price return of 11.73%...
